items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Rolfe Fairchild put out a small discography on me

ctx.x:
No, no. But I've got the test pressing. And they're all marked down in the discography that Rolfe Fairchild put out a small discography on me, and he knows about it, so it's in there.

So that's how I got to play. Now, it was these little things that start getting you publicity if you're little known. The story of -- that I've never told anyone, I don't know, but I just got through writing it for this book that Jan Hansen and I are putting out together. This story was I opened with Mezz and Danny -- I'm now at…
